subject: PromptSmith / Redwood interop & tracing integration roadmap
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@promptsmith.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PromptSmith x Redwood — interop & tracing integration kickoff?

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — I lead partnerships at PromptSmith (prompt engineering and registry tooling). We’ve been exploring tighter interoperability with inference platforms and wanted to propose a lightweight integration with Redwood focused on two things:

- A trace hook / telemetry adapter so PromptSmith can surface prompt provenance and prompt-versioning into Redwood traces (for cost/quality correlation).
- A small SDK shim so LangChain and LlamaIndex users who enable PromptSmith can get end-to-end traces without extra wiring.

We think the work breaks down into: 1) adapter spec, 2) LangChain/LlamaIndex examples, 3) joint e2e demo. I attached a short spec deck that outlines our proposed events and privacy knobs (attachment: promptsmith-integration-spec-v1.pdf).

Would love to set a 30-minute tech sync this week with your partner engineering and product folks. Can you introduce the right contact(s)? Also — happy to loop in LangChain and LlamaIndex if you prefer a single working group.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships, PromptSmith
elaine@promptsmith.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: promptsmith-integration-spec-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@promptsmith.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PromptSmith x Redwood — interop & tracing integration kickoff?

Thanks for the note and the spec, Elaine — excited to explore this. Short response: yes, we’re interested.

Suggested goals for the first phase:
- Define a minimal trace event contract (prompt.id, prompt.version, prompt.source, optional masked input hash).
- Produce two adapter examples: a LangChain middleware and a LlamaIndex connector that emit the contract to Redwood traces.
- Run an e2e demo with a sample prompt set and show token/cost correlation in Redwood Console.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Tech kickoff (30m) — this week if possible.
2) Adapter PoC (2 weeks) — PromptSmith provides lib + events; Redwood provides trace ingestion guide and a test harness.
3) Joint demo & docs (1 week).

Marissa (Partner Eng) and Stephanie (Product) are cc’d — can you share a preferred time and the sample telemetry payloads? If you can drop your repo/link and the demo recording that would be perfect.

Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-20T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: PromptSmith integration — proposed technical split

Quick internal summary after reviewing PromptSmith spec and the demo: solid fit for our trace-first approach. Proposed engineering plan (high level):

- Ownership: Marissa (partner eng) will drive adapter guidance; Jordan will own partner coordination; Stephanie will own product acceptance criteria.
- Tasks:
  1) Trace contract PR (this week) — define schema for prompt events (public fields only). Owner: Marissa. Jira: RED-4521.
  2) LangChain middleware (example) — inject prompt.id and masked input hash into Redwood trace spans. Owner: Partner Eng. Target: 10 working days.
  3) LlamaIndex connector example — similar adapter + docs. Owner: Eng SWAT. Target: 12 working days.
  4) Test harness + demo — we’ll use the PromptSmith sample repo and our internal trace test harness; run e2e and capture console dashboards. Owner: Jordan.

Privacy note: default behavior should not send raw prompt content; only prompt id/version + optional deterministic hash. We’ll add toggles in the adapter and document how to enable/disable sensitive fields.

I’ll open the GH repo and put a PR stub (https://github.com/redwood-inference/promptsmith-trace-adapter/pull/12). Also logging a working-session invite after we lock a time.

-Marissa
Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Samira Khan <samira@langchain.dev>

Date: 2027-08-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PromptSmith x Redwood — interop & tracing integration kickoff?

Appreciate the invite — LangChain engineering is on board to prototype a middleware. A couple quick notes from our side:

- We can add a lightweight trace hook that emits the PromptSmith contract into the LangChain event pipeline; it will be toggled behind a feature flag so users opt in.
- We prefer the adapter to use an explicit API surface (e.g., promptsmith.attach_metadata(prompt_id=..., version=...)) so it’s easy to audit.
- We’ll bring a small test harness (https://github.com/langchain/langchain-trace-tests) to validate end-to-end spans.

Proposed next step: 60-minute joint working session Monday 08/23 10am PT to finalize the contract and owners. If that works we’ll create a shared agenda and add a short checklist (adapter interface, privacy knobs, demo script).

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Engineering Program Manager, LangChain
samira@langchain.dev
